summary: OpenAI published a case study describing how Asana used Codex to replace a legacy testing system in two weeks for about $12,000, work it says would have taken five years of engineering effort.

mechanisms.reason: The case study describes an autonomous coding agent completing a multi-year engineering task, illustrating agent-driven displacement of traditional engineering labor.
mechanisms.quote: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.
